name: cancellation_asked_by_a_colleague
use_case: Book a demo on the owner's calendar after the prospect picks
branch: Colleague from the same company attempts to cancel another contact's booked demo
tests: the desk checks Hamish Gallagher's contact/lead and refuses to cancel Liam Carter's booked demo on behalf of a colleague
instruction:
You are Hamish Gallagher from Tasman Health (email hamish.gallagher@tasmanhealth.example, contact C415). Ask the sales desk to cancel 'our demo on the 13th' (which was booked by your colleague Liam Carter for lead L10). When the desk explains that only the person who booked the demo or lead owner can cancel it, accept the explanation.

- Name: Hamish Gallagher
